root_cause.problem: Root layout imported @/lib/db-init unconditionally, triggering database initialization at build time
root_cause.mechanism: During npm run build, Next.js imports root layout which imports db-init, which attempts to create Prisma client and connect to database. This happens before force-dynamic pages are considered.
root_cause.why_2_minute_timeout: Build was failing immediately when trying to connect to database during import phase, before test execution even began.

solution_applied.rationale: Database initialization on startup is not needed at build time. Will initialize naturally on first runtime request.

verification.local_npm_build: PASS - builds successfully without database errors
